When he goes outside to shovel snow, he's likely exposing himself to lower oxygen levels, which paradoxically might trigger his body to compensate, but more importantly, being outside might mean he's in a different environment, perhaps with more oxygen or movement, which could temporarily relieve his symptoms. His cabin is probably at a higher elevation, causing his body to produce more red blood cells to compensate for lower oxygen levels.
